# jumpcloud_application (Data Source)

Use this data source to read a JumpCloud application.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "jumpcloud_application" "finance" {
  id = "5f0c1234abcdef567890abcd"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The ID of the application.

### Read-Only

- `display_label` (String) Display label shown in the user portal.
- `logo` (Attributes) Application logo configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--logo))
- `name` (String) The name of the application.
- `sso` (Attributes) SSO settings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sso))
- `sso_url` (String) SSO URL for the application.

<a id="nestedatt--logo"></a>
### Nested Schema for `logo`

Read-Only:

- `url` (String) URL of the logo image.


<a id="nestedatt--sso"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sso`

Read-Only:

- `acs_url` (String) Assertion consumer service URL.
- `client_id` (String) Client ID (OIDC).
- `idp_entity_id` (String) Identity provider entity ID.
- `redirect_uris` (List of String) Redirect URIs (OIDC).
- `sp_entity_id` (String) Service provider entity ID.
- `type` (String) SSO type: saml or oidc.
